findings: Owner request 2026-11-09: practice long questions for Chapter 4 in the same format as the Physics chapter practice, long questions in the Computer Science Board shape (8 marks each) (English and Roman Urdu), written from the chapter; not printed in the book. 14 questions numbered 1-14; by section: 4.1 5, 4.2 9.

Covers windows and frames (a library window program), grid() forms (an admission form program), place() positioning, event-driven programming with a greeting program, a login form trace, database concepts (entity, attribute, relationship, identifier), relational database terms and keys, an sqlite3 create-insert-read program, the CRUD operations, update and delete programs with commit(), and the chapter's key terms. The exercise's long questions are not repeated (program-based angles are used). Every sqlite3 program was run in Python 3 and its real output is given; every Tkinter program was run and its window state checked. Read uses SELECT (Table 4.1 prints 'READ' in its Command column).
Every question carries a book_ref (topic id and exact words of that topic's English lesson), verified by tools.py.
The Roman Urdu file has the same checkpoints, order and book_refs; each prompt keeps the English question with the Roman Urdu meaning in brackets.
Drafts for the academic review (second-person review before publication).
